title: Broken DNS Resolution
rootCause: The configured DNS resolver is incorrect.
repairAction: Replace the invalid resolver with a working resolver.

title: Web Server Down
verification: curl localhost returns an HTTP response.

title: Disk Full
rootCause: A filesystem is at or near 100% capacity.
repairAction: Identify and remove/rotate the offending data according to the scenario rules.

title: Wrong Default Gateway
rootCause: The default route points to the wrong gateway.
repairAction: Correct the default route in the simulation.
verification: The gateway and external connectivity checks succeed.

title: Blocked Web Port
rootCause: The target service is reachable but the required port is blocked by the simulated firewall.
repairAction: Allow the required port in the scenario simulation.
verification: The connection to the target service succeeds.
